title: MedLit Extraction Result
description: Schema for structured extraction from medical-device and ophthalmic drug literature title/abstract text in the MedLit Ranking Tool MVP. Every field that cannot be determined must be null — never omitted. Every non-null value must carry an evidence_snippet taken verbatim from the source text. Both `device` and `drug` are optional: a paper may describe a device, a drug, both, or neither extractably. The LLM must never fabricate an empty section.

schema_version.description: 1.1.0 adds optional drug section and makes device optional/nullable.

source_scope.description: Declares what text was available to the extractor. MVP supports title+abstract only.

pmid.description: PubMed identifier of the source paper. Passed through from ingestion metadata, not LLM-extracted.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier of the source paper. Passed through from ingestion metadata, not LLM-extracted.

value.description: A concise 2–5 sentence synopsis grounded in the title/abstract. Must not assert regulatory claims.

supporting_evidence_snippets.description: Verbatim excerpts from the source text that support the synopsis.

label.description: LLM assessment of topical relevance to medical-device evidence. Used as one sub-signal in the relevance score (ranking_spec §2.1).

oneOf.description: Medical device described as the primary subject of the paper. Optional — set to null for drug-only papers or when no device is mentioned. Fields feed the ophthalmology normalization layer and map to Product Similarity sub-signals (ranking_spec §2.2).

product_name.description: Commercial or generic name of the device (e.g. 'AcrySof IQ', 'iStent inject W').

device_category.description: Device category raw string (e.g. 'intraocular lens', 'IOL', 'glaucoma drainage device'). Normalized to canonical values by the normalization layer.

intended_use.description: Primary intended use or purpose of the device.

indications.description: Clinical indications for use (e.g. 'cataract', 'keratoconus'). Raw strings — normalized by the normalization layer.

anatomical_site.description: Anatomical site (e.g. 'lens capsule', 'trabecular meshwork'). Raw string — normalized by the normalization layer.

material.description: Primary material or composition (e.g. 'hydrophobic acrylic', 'silicone', 'collamer'). Raw string — normalized to family/subtype/features by the normalization layer.

device_class.description: FDA device class (class I / II / III) when stated or inferable; otherwise null or unknown.

energy_source.description: Primary energy modality (e.g. laser, ultrasound, passive) — normalized downstream.

sterilization_method.description: Sterilization method (e.g. ETO, steam, gamma) — normalized downstream.

oneOf.description: Ophthalmic drug described as the primary subject of the paper. Optional — set to null for device-only papers or when no drug is mentioned. Fields feed the ophthalmology drug normalization layer.

product_name.description: Brand or trade name of the drug (e.g. 'Lucentis', 'Ozurdex', 'Restasis').

active_ingredient.description: Generic / INN name of the active ingredient (e.g. 'ranibizumab', 'dexamethasone'). Raw string — normalized to canonical ingredient by the normalization layer.

drug_class.description: Drug class as stated in the paper (e.g. 'anti-VEGF', 'corticosteroid', 'prostaglandin analogue'). Raw string — normalized to canonical class.

route.description: Route of administration as stated (e.g. 'intravitreal', 'topical', 'sustained release implant'). Raw string — normalized.

indications.description: Clinical indications (e.g. 'wet AMD', 'diabetic macular edema'). Raw strings — normalized.

formulation_features.description: Formulation features explicitly mentioned (e.g. 'preservative-free', 'sustained release', 'unit dose').

study.description: Study design and population characteristics. Fields feed Evidence Quality scoring (ranking_spec §2.4).

sample_size.description: Total number of participants, specimens, or observations (n).

population_description.description: Brief description of the study population (age range, condition, setting).

follow_up_duration.description: Follow-up duration as stated in the paper (e.g. '12 months', '6 weeks'). Null if not reported.

follow_up_months.description: Numeric follow-up duration in whole months when extractable; used for Evidence Quality scoring. Null if not reported.

oneOf.description: Primary comparator arm for Evidence Quality (FDA-style hierarchy).

metrics.description: Structured numeric or semi-structured outcome metrics extracted from the paper. Empty array if no comparable metrics are reported. Feeds Metric Favorability scoring (ranking_spec §2.3).

qualitative_findings.description: Non-numeric findings or safety/efficacy tags supported by evidence text. Empty array if none.

regulatory.description: Regulatory context mentioned in the paper. IMPORTANT: approval status must NEVER be inferred — only report what is explicitly stated in the text.

value.description: Regulatory status explicitly stated in the paper. Use 'not_mentioned' when the paper does not address it.

evidence_snippet.description: Verbatim excerpt that explicitly states the regulatory status. Required when value is not 'not_mentioned'.

trial_registration.description: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT number or equivalent registry ID, if stated.

extraction_warnings.description: Warnings generated during extraction (e.g. 'sample_size could not be determined', 'multiple devices mentioned — primary device selected'). Empty array if none.

evidence_section.description: Which section of the source text the evidence_snippet was drawn from.

value.description: Controlled vocabulary study design label used by the ranking algorithm (ranking_spec §2.4).
Evidence domain used for the evidence quality cap (ranking_spec §2.4).

metric_name_normalized.description: Normalized metric label used by downstream scoring to match against user-supplied target metrics (e.g. 'mace_rate', 'hba1c_reduction', 'adverse_event_rate').

metric_name_raw.description: The metric name as it appears verbatim in the title/abstract.

value_type.description: Declares which value fields are populated.

numeric_value.description: Primary numeric value. Required when value_type is 'numeric' or 'percentage'.

value_min.description: Lower bound. Required when value_type is 'range'.

value_max.description: Upper bound. Required when value_type is 'range'.

text_value.description: Textual value. Required when value_type is 'text' or 'binary'.

unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. '%', 'mmHg', 'months'). Null if dimensionless.

confidence_interval_low.description: Lower bound of 95% confidence interval, if reported.

confidence_interval_high.description: Upper bound of 95% confidence interval, if reported.

p_value.description: p-value associated with this metric, if reported.

timepoint.description: Timepoint at which the metric was measured (e.g. '12 months', 'discharge', 'end of follow-up').

comparator.description: Comparator arm or group if this is a comparative metric (e.g. 'vs. bare-metal stent').

evidence_snippet.description: Verbatim excerpt from the source text that directly supports this metric. Required — never null.

severity.description: Severity qualifier if stated (e.g. 'mild', 'severe', 'grade 3'). Null if not reported.
